name: mode
note: Isolates 3D66. Its 284 zeros and 279 ones are a strictly paired toggle, and in the original scripts the pair always brackets a camera scroll plus dialogue — but dialogue redraws most of the screen, so this stage toggles the switch with nothing between and holds still on each side. Any difference is then the switch's own. A unit is deployed with the camera on it and selected, so cursor and selection UI are on screen and would show up if the switch hides them. Uses a save for entry and an early exit, so the run costs a fraction of the VI budget.

deployments.note: 豹馬 — the unit the camera watches
